headline: The ice-cream man keeps the hot afternoon — and a two-frame race cost main its green
lede: HOMEBODY's lot got its fourth hour-citizen: the truck rolls in at 14:00 or 16:00, the kids hear the jingle first, and the till pays. Meanwhile the red-main repair closed out: the golden-trace fix passed the full nightly static tier, and the last smoke loss turned out to be the harness racing its own paint.

notes.text: #2503 HOMEBODY ice-cream truck shipped (6de72c6): arithmetic stop-hour, paid tap-buy with honest broke refusals, one serving per cone, Pip beats the toy box to the curb, the cone leaves with the truck. peoplecheck 620/0 with a independently re-proven mutant; resumed from the previous lane's pushed corpse.

#2498 diagnosed end-to-end: the PILES IN! smoke loss was a harness race — the chain seats in sim state two polls before the HUD div carries the text, and the loop exited on the state detection. Fixed (#2512), exciteplay green 46/46; the gauntlet Y-seat flake is the known late-seat family, left alone.

Any browser gate that exits on a state condition and reads DOM text in the same loop races the step-boundary render write. And donor node_modules are fragile: a sibling lane's cleanup can break your playwright mid-diagnosis — own your install.
gh pr merge can print 'Base branch was modified' on an attempt that actually merged — check the PR state before retrying, not the error text.
